title: Recovering Direct Price Effects of Environmental Amenities in Housing Markets: Regression and Causal Machine Learning Model Assessment with Empirical Monte Carlo Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2606.02795v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Hedonic price models are widely used to value environmental amenities, yet practical guidance for estimating direct unconfounded price effects remains sparse. We conduct an empirical Monte Carlo simulation to evaluate traditional regression and causal machine learning (CML) approaches for estimating the direct unmediated price effect of spatially delineated amenities on treated properties (DUET), a lower-bound approximation of welfare change with direct applications to benefit-cost analysis. Whereas previous simulations rely on parametric assumptions, we preserve the actual data-generating process underlying over 1 million property transactions from upstate New York (1990--2024) and randomly assign treatment locations across iterations, establishing a ground truth against which estimation error can be measured precisely. Generalized difference-in-differences (DID) regression consistently outperforms baseline DID and two-way fixed eff

translated_title: 恢复住房市场中环境舒适品的直接价格效应：基于经验蒙特卡洛模拟的回归与因果机器学习模型评估
translated_abstract: 特征价格（享乐价格）模型被广泛用于评估环境舒适品的价值，但关于如何估计直接且未受混淆的价格效应的实用指导仍然稀少。我们开展了一项经验蒙特卡洛模拟，以评估传统回归方法与因果机器学习方法在估计空间划定舒适品对受处理房产的直接非中介价格效应（DUET）方面的表现——DUET是福利变化的一个下界近似，可直接应用于成本效益分析。与以往依赖参数假设的模拟不同，我们保留了纽约州北部超过100万笔房产交易（1990–2024年）背后的真实数据生成过程，并在各次迭代中随机分配处理位置，从而建立一个真值基准，据此可以精确测量估计误差。结果表明，广义双重差分回归始终优于基线双重差分和双向固定效应等方法。
tldr: 该研究利用基于纽约州百万房产交易真实数据生成过程的经验蒙特卡洛模拟，系统评估了回归与因果机器学习方法在估计环境舒适品直接价格效应上的表现，发现广义双重差分回归方法表现最为稳健。
en_tdlr: Using an empirical Monte Carlo simulation grounded in the actual data-generating process of over one million property transactions in upstate New York, this study evaluates regression and causal machine learning methods for estimating direct unmediated price effects of environmental amenities, finding that generalized difference-in-differences regression consistently outperforms alternative approaches.
